title: Recording at the Plantation Cafe with Oliver; Stump Evans; Oliver's arranging
summary: Barbarin recalls working at the Plantation when the record was made, identifies Stump Evans, remarks that Oliver was declining, and says Oliver gave ideas and dressed up stock tunes without arrangements.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline
